# Simba

> Leader election and distributed mutex for the JVM. Contenders compete for a named mutex; MySQL (JDBC), Redis or Zookeeper grants one of them a time-bounded lease, with ordered acquire/release callbacks and a fencing token per ownership term. Local ownership is a weakly consistent view of the backend: resources that must reject a paused former owner have to check the fencing token.
